name: orchestration
input_contract: Any new request unless explicitly opted out. For non-trivial work with an unknown runtime path, ownership, caller flow, tests/config, generated/legacy, or cross-package or cross-repository path, Sol starts proactive reconnaissance (RECON) with evidence-only explorer or deep_explorer before broad primary search; Status answers, strict micro-edits, and decision-complete worker phases skip RECON only when location/runtime path and contract are known.
output_contract: A Sol-owned decision and acceptance response, optionally backed by a cited RECONNAISSANCE RETURN with ANSWER, RUNTIME PATH, RELEVANT REGIONS (observed/inferred), CONTRACT / TEST EVIDENCE, CONTRADICTIONS / UNKNOWNS, SEARCH COVERAGE, READ NEXT, and SOL DECISION NEEDED; execution handoffs report status, changed files, checks, gaps, and risk. Browser/runtime QA records selected route, availability, and fallback reason using exact selection first, then capability-first defaults or an exact-capability blocker.
rollback_boundary: Revert only this skill package's files; do not mutate child worktrees, external services, or user roles.
